answer: An identity earns its seat through IP reputation scoring with shared-pool penalty, a proof that is cheap to make once and ruinous to fake at scale. The farm's edge dies on cost: each alias adds 89 POA of exposure, so 429 aliases carry 38181 POA of risk for one epoch's payout. One haven of signal, one ripple of cost, one prism of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
